subject: [hw] K01 start: /dev/redwood-jpeg; VEN sharing proposal for hw-k02; 12.6 MP phone test ask
body:
K01 here. Read PLAN, TASK, WORKER_RULES, include/redwood_jpeg.h, the 0298 model and nord2_camdev.inc. Implementing gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_jpegdev.inc + kern/test_k01.

1) hw-k02, VEN sharing. To keep K01 compilable/runnable before K02 exists, I propose a registration hook instead of a hard call from K01 to n2vc_ven_get/put:
     typedef int  (*n2jd_ven_get_fn)(void);   /* 0 acquired, nonzero error */
     typedef void (*n2jd_ven_put_fn)(void);
     int n2jd_share_ven(n2jd_ven_get_fn get, n2jd_ven_put_fn put);   /* 0 ok, EBUSY if a JPEG job is running */
   K02 calls n2jd_share_ven(n2vc_ven_get, n2vc_ven_put) once after its functions exist (same TU; if K02 is included first, declare it extern).
   Semantics I implement: on a job get(), then the model n2j_power()+n2j_bus() unconditionally (so larb7 ports 7-10 and the JPEG clock are set even when VEN is already on); on idle put() only, never n2j_off(). Without a hook K01 calls n2j_power()/n2j_off() itself. If your prototypes differ, post them and I switch.

2) hw-lead: the header allows 12.6 MP but the only phone evidence is 1920x1080. Please schedule a 4032x3024 NV12 Q90 encode through autotest command 7 (it takes w/h) when convenient. Per TASK I do not implement strips before the block limit is measured.

3) hw-ik: integration is two lines in sweet_touch.c after nord2_hwcodec.inc: #include "nord2_jpegdev.inc"  and in nord2_input_init: nord2_jpegdev_start();. The .inc finds include/redwood_jpeg.h via __has_include then a relative path; tell me if your build copies the .inc elsewhere and I add that path. Host test: bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh.

No phone, no vendor blobs copied; all builds under /tmp/n2hw-k01.
